uncertain: Both side elevations are captioned only 'elewacja boczna'; assigned from the plan: the one with the three-pane bay, terrace door 270/230 and long balcony is LEFT, the one with the garage gable (window 150/120, balcony door above) is RIGHT. Neither is mirrored.

The two 45-degree panes of the bay window are listed only on LEFT. They are also visible, foreshortened, on FRONT (about x 227-256, y 462-555) and on REAR (about x 1041-1065, y 466-553) and are deliberately not listed there.
FRONT and REAR wall ends include the bay window (its outer face) on one end and the garage on the other, i.e. the printed 1592. The main body alone spans x 260-934 on FRONT and x 361-1033 on REAR.

LEFT and RIGHT wall ends span the printed 1002 (main body 922 plus the 80 projection, whose side wall is visible behind). On LEFT the main gable wall alone is x 351-887; on RIGHT the garage gable wall alone is x 465-905.
The ridge row is the top of the ridge tiles; it computes to about 8.5 m above the zero row on all four elevations against the printed +8,40 (about 0.1 m, 6 px).
The front gabled part is a wall projecting 80 forward with its own gable (recorded as WALL_GABLE; CROSS_GABLE would also be defensible). The rear stair dormer is flush with the rear wall.
Bottom edges of the upper balcony doors are behind open balustrades; they were set at the balcony floor line (row 417 on FRONT, row 406 on LEFT).
The page prints no garage ridge level; on the front elevation the garage ridge is at about row 180 (about 7.1 m above zero by scale).
